title: Lure the Rook Home
setup: The rook on b8 is the only guard of the back rank, and your queen stands in front of your rook on d1.
hint: The rook is doing all the defending. Offer it something on the eighth rank that it has to take.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} is a queen thrown onto the back rank, and {{Rxd8}} is forced. The rook has been pulled onto the one square your own rook covers, and {{Rxd8#}} mates a king locked in by its pawns.
